root_cause: Powerhouse could diagnose missing Composio authentication and generate Connect Links once a key existed, but had no admin-authenticated path to validate and store the project API key in canonical Vault.
prevention: External provider API keys enter Powerhouse only through admin-authenticated server-side onboarding.
Validate the key against the provider before storing it.
Use a narrow service-role-only RPC dedicated to COMPOSIO_API_KEY; never expose a generic Vault writer.
Never persist provider keys in browser storage, repository files, logs, Brain records, or response bodies.
